title: Remote viewer sees Tunguska as an exploding saucer of escapees

tellings.quote: >> He says it was um uh people in a saucer.

related.note: This is the same 1908 Tunguska event, but McMoneagle's remote viewing explains it as an exploding saucer carrying escapees, not a natural air burst.

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, retells what Joe McMoneagle saw. McMoneagle is a remote viewer, someone who claims to describe faraway places and times using only the mind. He looked at Tunguska, the huge 1908 explosion over a Siberian forest, and, according to Jorjani, said it was people in a saucer, escapees whose craft blew up.
